conversation.Statement: Hello, this is Lisa from Amazon Support. Am I speaking with Jamie Nelson?
Yes, this is Jamie. I got an email about something with my account but I don't really understand it.

Thank you for confirming, Jamie. I see you're a new customer, so I'd like to help you. The email was sent because we detected unusual activity during your recent purchase attempt. No need to worry, we'll fix this together.
Oh, okay. I only ordered a phone case, so I'm not sure what the issue would be.

That makes sense, and sometimes small purchases like that can trigger our security checks. For your protection, your Amazon account was temporarily restricted. To resolve this, I'll just need to verify some details. Is that alright?
Um, sure. What do you need?
Could you please confirm the email address you use to log in to Amazon? I want to make sure I'm looking at the correct account.
It's jamie.nelson88@gmail.com.
Perfect, thank you. And just to confirm, what is the billing address you have on file with us?
Uh, 214 Maple Street, Dayton, OH.

Thank you, Jamie. Everything matches. Now, due to the system alert, Amazon needs you to validate your account from a secure portal. I'll send you a link to our verification page. Are you at your computer or can you access a web browser on your phone?
Yes, I have my laptop in front of me.
Great. Please open your browser and type in www.amzn-verify-help.com. Let me know when you see the Amazon verification page.
Alright, I see a page that says 'Amazon Account Verification'.
Excellent. This is our secure verification portal. Please click on the yellow button labeled 'Start Verification'.
Okay, I clicked it. Now it wants me to enter my Amazon login.
That's correct. Please enter your email and Amazon password. This will help us verify and unlock your account.
Done. It says it's checking my details.
Thank you for completing that step. The system is now asking for payment verification due to the flagged activity. Have you recently received any emails about pending refunds or payments?
I think so, there was something about a refund for a tablet, but I never ordered a tablet.

That's concerning. It appears someone may have tried to make a fraudulent purchase using your account. To resolve this and initiate your refund, Amazon requires a security deposit that will be refunded to you. This is temporary and fully refundable.
A deposit? I've never heard of that before.

I completely understand your concern, Jamie. This is a new Amazon policy for first-time customers when suspicious activity is detected, just as a precaution. It's a standard process, and I'll guide you through each step.
Okay... what do I have to do?

For your security, we ask that you purchase Amazon gift cards totalling $500. Once you provide the codes, your account will be unlocked and the amount will be immediately refunded to your card. I'll stay with you the entire time to ensure it's smooth.
Wait, so I have to buy gift cards and send you the codes?

Yes, that's correct. Amazon uses gift cards for instant verification because it's secure and traceable within our system. You won't lose any money, once the verification completes, the deposit is refunded straight back. I can wait on the line while you make the purchase.
Alright, I guess I can go to the store now.
Thank you, Jamie. I'll stay on the line to assist you. Please let me know once you have the gift cards, and I'll walk you through entering the codes for verification.
Okay, I'm back. I bought five $100 gift cards.
Perfect. Now, please scratch the back of the first card and read me the code. I'll enter it into our secure system for you.
Alright, the first code is X7G2-4J5Y-LM9P-TR8S.
Thank you. Please continue with the next four codes, whenever you're ready.
They are Q1HD-8N2K-Z5RP-Y6WU, G4LP-7V6C-F2BX-M3QZ, T9HU-1KJL-8W2V-N4YX, and D7SJ-3B5C-Q8LR-M1NT.
Thank you, Jamie. All codes have been submitted. Your account status should update within a few minutes. In the meantime, please don't log out of your Amazon account or disconnect from this call.
Alright. When will the refund show up?

The refund typically appears in your bank account within 30 to 60 minutes. I will monitor the status and confirm with you as soon as the funds have been issued. Is there anything else you'd like me to clarify or help with while we wait?
